question: In which of the following states is the Sirki Waterfall located?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Arunachal Pradesh.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sirki Waterfall** is located at a distance of approx 10 kms from Pasighat in Arunachal Pradesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kunchikal Falls **in Shimoga District Karnataka is the highest waterfall in India with a height of 1493 feet.
 
• **Dudhsagar falls **is known as the ‘Sea of milk’, it is formed from the Mandovi River.
 
• Ranchi, the capital city of Jharkhand is known as the **city of waterfalls** in India.
 
• Mawsynram, located in the northeastern state of Meghalaya, is recognized as the wettest region in the world.
